method.brief: A real Unreal Engine test room containing a visible emissive orange sphere whose light affects surrounding walls and floor; technically readable exposure, no black failed render

before.judge_fix: Missing emissive orange sphere; add an orange sphere with realistic lighting effects on walls/floor to meet the brief.

after.judge_fix: Slight overexposure on sun causes washout; reduce brightness slightly for cleaner light affect

comparison.bounded_conclusion: The recovered settings produced a materially different, non-black, locally judged deliverable in this UE 5.8 test scene. The result is overexposed and does not establish general tutorial-to-skill reliability.
